name: Samsung Climate Control Co., Ltd.
summary: Headquartered in Changwon-si, South Korea, Samsung Climate Control Co., Ltd. is an international manufacturer and distributor of essential automotive components. The company's diverse product range focuses on thermal management solutions for vehicles, offering items such as cooling modules, radiators, charge air coolers, oil coolers, air conditioning condensers, combi coolers, EGR coolers, surge tanks, and automatic transmission fluid warmers. Established in 1954, the enterprise was originally known as Samsung Gongupsa until June 2000, when it adopted its current corporate identity.
